integrity: The finite-shape classification follows directly from the exact Gamma-ratio factorization and derivative signs. The large-total-count expansion uses the standard digamma asymptotic plus a mean-value argument; numerical roots were used only as stress tests, not as proof.
limitations: Restricted to the standard positive real shape coordinate, a fixed interior probability vector, and a fixed cell. Boundary zero-mass cells, probability-coordinate monotonicity, coupled parameter rays, and nonlinear reparameterizations are not classified. An equivalent elementary calculation could exist under poorly indexed negative-binomial likelihood terminology.
title: Shape-parameter obstruction and exact mode for negative-multinomial cells
